scope: A07 blinded calibration 32 packets only; no evaluation or full-corpus tuning
position_rule: Report first candidate in DOM order with saved preceding S word count and total S word count. Preserve no-position as null, true zero as 0, and a zero-denominator fraction as NA.

code_block.source: DOM pre/code block or equivalent saved block node

calibration_examples.limit: Blinded packet supplies body char range but no raw DOM locator.
Blinded packet supplies body char range but no raw DOM locator.

inline_code.source: DOM code node outside a pre or code block

calibration_examples.limit: Inline token is omitted from the saved prose source unit.
Inline token is omitted from the saved prose source unit.

ordered_list.source: DOM ol containing li; retain the list node and first item locator
ordered_list.annotation: mechanical numbered-list candidate, never a semantic procedure label

negative_calibration_examples.reason: The 27 numbered functions are a contents or item enumeration.
The numbered hosting offers are a ranking or catalog.
Step headings in body text do not prove a DOM ol node.

numbered_procedure_candidate.source: subset of DOM ol with direct li only; retain ol node, matching li locators, and first position
numbered_procedure_candidate.fixed_rule: Accept an ol if any direct li begins with Step followed by a digit and punctuation, or if at least two of its first three direct li begin with one of the fixed imperative cues. Strip the browser-generated list marker before checking. This remains a mechanical candidate, not a semantic procedure label.

negative_calibration_examples.reason: Numbered function names do not begin with a step cue.
Numbered provider names do not begin with a step cue.

numbered_procedure_candidate.limit: Blinded packets lack raw DOM nodes, so these examples calibrate cue words only. DOM ol membership is verified later against saved source, before any semantic interpretation.

number_with_unit_in_prose.source: all saved P/L/U prose units, represented by paragraph and list_item kinds in the 32 blinded packets; exclude code and URLs, but do not narrow to paragraph-only
number_with_unit_in_prose.fixed_grammar: Apply range_pattern plus suffix_boundary first. Remove its matched spans, then apply value_pattern + separator_pattern + unit_pattern_case_insensitive + suffix_boundary. Reject any candidate whose half-open span overlaps a saved URL token span in the same prose unit. Allow only the listed intervening words registered and million. Keep unmatched expressions unmatched; do not add adjectives after evaluation.

URL_exclusion.input: Saved URL token spans as zero-based half-open character offsets in the same P/L/U prose unit as the numeric match.
URL_exclusion.overlap_rule: Exclude candidate [start,end) if any saved URL token [url_start,url_end) satisfies start < url_end and url_start < end.

calibration_examples.limit: Registered intervenes between value and unit; this exact phrase needs a documented optional adjective rule or stays unmatched.
The range grammar returns the full range; do not silently use its endpoint as the value.

acceptance_cases.basis: S02 independent audit confirmed a true numeric zero plus unit; this is a syntax check, not a newly observed calibration article.
Zero is an observed numeric value when followed by a unit.
The full range is one candidate.
The registered intervening word is fixed.
A version number is not a unit expression.
A digit after the unit makes the apparent 2GB a partial match.
An underscore after the unit makes the apparent 2GB a partial match.
Letters after the range unit make it a partial match.
A digit after the range unit makes it a partial match.
The 2GB match overlaps the saved URL token span [0,28).

constraint_or_prerequisite.source: all saved P/L/U prose units, represented by paragraph and list_item kinds in the 32 blinded packets; code is excluded
constraint_or_prerequisite.annotation: lexical candidate only; inspect whether the clause constrains the described operation

freeze_rule: Freeze this dictionary before reading evaluation packets; independent reviewer and parent decide the frozen version.
